The Corps trails page gives system totals only: 24 miles of 10-ft asphalt walking/biking trail, 11 miles of single-track mountain bike trail, 26 miles of equestrian trail (a Corps photo caption says over 25 miles). Equestrian trails are on the southeast side with trailheads at Crows Nest and Jack Rabbit Bend; trails east of Collins Road lie in Public Hunting Areas, so use caution in hunting seasons.
